# Raspberry Pi Foundation

> A charity helping young people learn computing and digital making through free resources, teacher support, clubs, and research.

The Raspberry Pi Foundation provides coding projects, classroom resources, professional development, curriculum materials, research, and community programmes that support computing education worldwide.

## Learn
- [Learn](https://www.raspberrypi.org/learn/): Main hub for coding activities, learning pathways, and youth-focused computing resources.
- [Learn to code online](https://projects.raspberrypi.org/): Free step-by-step coding and digital making projects for young people.
- [Explore our projects](https://projects.raspberrypi.org/): Browse project tutorials covering Scratch, Python, web, and physical computing.
- [Learn at a Code Club](https://codeclub.org/): Find beginner-friendly coding activities and club-based learning opportunities.
- [Your code in space](https://www.raspberrypi.org/your-code-in-space/): Space-themed coding challenge that lets young people write programs for real missions.
- [Coolest Projects](https://www.raspberrypi.org/coolest-projects/): Global showcase where young creators share digital tech projects and ideas.

## Teaching
- [Teach](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/): Teaching hub with classroom resources, lesson materials, and educator support.
- [Support for teachers](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/): Access teaching guidance, lesson plans, and curriculum-linked resources.
- [AI education](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/ai-education): Resources and guidance for teaching AI and machine learning concepts.
- [Hello World magazine](https://www.raspberrypi.org/hello-world): Free magazine and articles for computing educators and school leaders.
- [Online training courses](https://www.raspberrypi.org/courses): Free online professional development courses for computing teachers.
- [Resources for teachers & schools](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/): Materials to support classroom teaching across age groups and settings.

## Curriculum & Programmes
- [The Computing Curriculum](https://www.raspberrypi.org/curriculum/): Comprehensive computing curriculum resources for schools and educators.
- [Ada Computer Science](https://adacomputerscience.org/): Complete computer science learning platform for students and teachers.
- [Experience CS](https://experience-cs.org/): Introductory computer science programme with teaching materials and student activities.
- [Experience AI](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/ai-education): Classroom resources introducing artificial intelligence through practical activities.
- [Professional development for teachers](https://www.raspberrypi.org/courses): Structured courses to build subject knowledge and teaching confidence.

## Code Club
- [Code Club](https://codeclub.org/): Global network of coding clubs for young people learning with peers.
- [Start a Code Club](https://codeclub.org/en/start-a-code-club/): Guidance for volunteers and educators starting a local coding club.
- [Learn at a Code Club](https://codeclub.org/): Activities, projects, and support for club leaders and participants.
- [Coding for kids](https://www.raspberrypi.org/learn/): Beginner-friendly coding content suitable for children and young learners.

## Research & Impact
- [Research & Impact](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/): Overview of the Foundation’s research, evidence, and educational impact work.
- [Explore our findings](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/): Research insights into computing education and learning outcomes.
- [Our impact](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/impact): Reports and evidence showing the reach and outcomes of Foundation programmes.
- [Research projects](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/projects): Ongoing and completed studies in computing education and digital learning.
- [Research publications](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/publications): Papers, reports, and publications from the Foundation’s research team.
- [Online events and seminars](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/research/seminars): Seminar series featuring computing education researchers and practitioners.

## Courses & Training
- [Courses](https://www.raspberrypi.org/courses): Free online courses for teachers, mentors, and learners in computing.
- [Online training courses](https://www.raspberrypi.org/courses): Self-paced and guided professional development for educators.
- [Teach](https://www.raspberrypi.org/teach/): Entry point for teacher training, classroom support, and subject development.
- [Hello World magazine](https://www.raspberrypi.org/hello-world): Professional learning content, teaching ideas, and educator community stories.

## Community & Events
- [Coolest Projects](https://www.raspberrypi.org/coolest-projects/): International event celebrating projects built by young digital makers.
- [Your code in space](https://www.raspberrypi.org/your-code-in-space/): Challenge programme connecting coding with space science and exploration.
- [Code Club](https://codeclub.org/): Community programme helping young people learn to code in clubs.
- [Blog](https://www.raspberrypi.org/blog): News, stories, announcements, and updates from the Foundation.

## News & Organisation
- [News](https://www.raspberrypi.org/blog): Latest articles, announcements, and stories about programmes and education.
- [About us](https://www.raspberrypi.org/about/): Information about the Foundation’s mission, work, and organisation.
- [Research](https://www.raspberrypi.org/research-impact/): Learn about the Foundation’s evidence-based approach to computing education.
- [Homepage](https://www.raspberrypi.org/): Main entry point to learning, teaching, research, and community programmes.
